text:
elena: taking the preflight SLO snapshot for EU window (06:00 UTC). planning to gate on the usuals + gpu orchestration queue depth. anyone want to add anything?
ryan: include p95 per-route, embed p99, 5xx, kv-cache miss, error-budget burn, and model-variant fallbacks. queue_depth for gpu nodes + kernel_fallback counter.
sumit: also add scheduling wait time and OOM-retry count. saw a transient in eu-03 last week.
metrics-bot: preflight-snapshot created by @elena -> snap_id=snap-20240322-eu-516789, dashboards captured: p95-latency, p99-embed, 5xx-rate, kv-cache-miss, gpu-queue-depth, kernel-fallbacks. https://grafana.redwood/snap/snap-20240322-eu-516789
metrics-bot: ALERT_SIM: embed-route p95 up ~28% vs baseline over past 35m (baseline 112ms -> 144ms). trace sample trace-eu-516x.
elena: did staging get a runtime variant?
ryan: yes, quantize-v2 rc3 pushed to staging at ~03:20 UTC. no prod change.
sumit: pulling trace-eu-516x now for kernel_fallback events and scheduling wait.
ryan: logs show a cluster of kernel_fallbacks on gpu-11 + a 2x increase in scheduling wait during the spike window. small amount of 502 tails but mostly degraded tails.
elena: given that, i'm in favor of holding the EU shift and pinning eu-embed to the previous stable v2.1.4-rc2 for the window. we'll run the kernel regression matrix on rc3 overnight.
sumit: agree. add a changelog line and include quick mitigation steps for ops.
deploy-bot: PIN_RECORD: actor=@elena route=eu-embed pinned_version=v2.1.4-rc2 reason="staging p95 regression correlated with kernel_fallbacks on rc3" ticket=RED-4219
metrics-bot: quick smoke on pinned version (2k sample): p95=115ms, 5xx=0.06%, kv-miss=2.0%, gpu-queue-depth median=1.2 -> smoke OK.
ryan: plan: 1) update release notes & changelog with hold + pin, 2) run kernel regression + scheduling matrix overnight on rc3, 3) re-eval at 04:30 UTC and final go/no-go at 05:00 UTC.
elena: ramp plan if green: staggered 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> full. abort criteria: p95 > 1.25x baseline OR 5xx > 0.5% OR scheduling_wait > 2x baseline OR kernel_fallback_rate > 2x baseline.
sumit: i'll add an emergency unpin and rollback snippet to the release notes: `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2` and `deploy-bot rollback --route eu-embed --to-version v2.1.4-rc2 --force`
ryan: also note ops runbook for quick verification: `curl -s https://grafana.redwood/api/datasource/proxy/1/query?var-snap=snap-20240322-eu-516789 | jq .` (example)
metrics-bot: ramp_policy saved -> {10,25,50,100}, abort_criteria saved to RED-4219.
deploy-bot: ticket RED-4219 updated with pin, ramp plan, trace links, and runbook snippets.
elena: tagging oncall: @ryan @sumit please ack the hold and monitor overnight tests. i'll merge the release notes PR with the hold wording and pin info.
ryan: ack. i'll run the scheduling/regression matrix overnight and post results.
sumit: ack. i'll leave a short blurb in platform-ops so the rotation sees it during the window. :thumbsup:
elena: final: no traffic shift until 05:00 UTC re-eval. if green follow the staggered ramp. closing thread, will update after 04:30 snapshot.
(END)
